about: Everything the mod is, as built - kept in the repo (docs/workshop/modnow.json) and updated with every build. The workshop's "The mod now" tab is drawn from it.
sections: The game

Skyrim played as Black Ops 3 Zombies: nights of the dead in each of Skyrim's 10 Dragon Priest cities (Riverwood, Whiterun, Solitude, Windhelm, Markarth, Riften, Falkreath, Morthal, Dawnstar, Winterhold), rounds that climb, Cursed Essence earned on every kill.
The dead come down red beams of light from the sky. No XP from them; no casters, archers or shouting enemies at night (Dragon Priests and dragons keep their powers).

The dead (Nov 26, your keep/remove marks): Mihail's zombies (walkers, headless, dread, deranged runners), our six Thriceborn, Rag Draugr and Restless Rag Draugr, Rotten and Bloody Skeletons, the Feral Death Hound, the Hulking Draugr, Ash Spawn and Immolators, the Frost Brute, the Hunger, the Ogrim and the Winged Twilight. Bosses: Grimmvar (a Vile dragon, every 10th night), the Hunting Ground King (from 10), Gehenoth (from 15), Grahzah (a level-4 Necro dragon, from 20). Mini-bosses: the Giant Brute Berserker, Minotaur Lord, Ogrim Lord and a Plague Dragon. 99 others taken out.

Dragons are half size and fly as Skyrim flies them; a dragon boss's breath and the dead it calls land on the ground near you. The three word-dragons: Sanguine (flesh), Aether (time), Otherworld (undoing); the Echo of Alduin a level-7 Dark dragon.

Bosses: night 5 one of your kept mini-bosses at random (Giant Brute, Minotaur Lord, Ogrim Lord, Plague Dragon), the Hunting Ground King from 10, Gehenoth from 15, Grahzah from 20. No noise hunter (off since Nov 17).

Movement (your BO3 movement): the sprint winds up (180 ms) to 440 and widens the view 7 degrees; the slide (sprint + crouch) tilts the view 3 degrees and its speed carries into a jump; light swings 1.2x.

The ability ladder: the class weapons' Tier I light ability, Tier II heavy, Tier III ultimate from a 25-kill meter (Aetherial Host, Starfall, Soul Harvest, Spell Lance); each Ascend +15% damage, +10% size.

On screen: the night counter a plain number top left with the quests under it; the essence bottom left; the held weapon's card bottom right; the ultimate's meter above the perks; no banners or hints; a 10 s countdown before a night only.
Deaths: a kill by shadow, spirit or arcane tears the soul out (a white beam, Alduin's soul sound); heavies throw the body at half strength; the rest still through FEC until ours replace it.
Free every city at its Echo Altar; the questline ends right before Skyrim's own Alduin fight. The last three dragons and the Echo of Alduin are the hardest fights.
Solo first; co-op for 1 to 4 players (Skyrim Together, optional). Releasing free on Nexus.
Special nights: The Pack, Daedric Incursion, Armored Champions, Blood Fog.
After night 10: kill essence tapers, and Tablet, upgrade and Armory prices rise 3% a night (brews stay fixed).
Hit feel: no hit pause and no shake (Nov 26). Bodies fly half as far (Alduin's Bane as before).
New character
One loading screen from NEW to the character creator (sliders only, by body area); our own launch screen (the Alduin painting) and menu music.
At Riverwood you choose your Helgen companion (Ralof or Hadvar) and Survival Mode on or off. No starting weapons. Skyrim's own underwear on both bodies (3BA, HIMBO).
The class is chosen later, at the Echo Altar (changing it costs 50,000 Cursed Essence; one shared inventory).
Each city: the Echo Altar

Four trials, in order, at night, shared by the party: Lay the Restless to Rest (souls fly to the stone as white fireballs, the ring of light fills smoothly), The Stone's Whisper (Felldir's Whisper once six are free), Hold the Light, Break the Priest's Seals.
The last seal calls the city's Dragon Priest at once; his fall frees the city and drops his relic to every player.
Felldir the Old speaks from each freed altar's centre stone (his own ElevenLabs voice, a short stone echo, centred subtitles). Talk: four topics, 244 lines and 67 whispers, opening as the story goes.
The altar menu: choose your class, Your Kit (claim your weapon, armour set and spells), the Armory, the Tablet of Mysteries, brews.
The four classes
Summoner: the Radiant Quarterstaff (Steel, Ebony, Daedric, Dragonbone by tier), conjurations of our own; wonder: the Soulcaller's Staff; Necromancer robes.
Battle-mage (Destruction): the Carian Wand (Steel, Stalhrim, Glass, Daedric by tier), Destruction spells; wonder: the Wyrmspine Javelin (tap jabs, hold throws); Arch-Mage's robes.
Alchemist: the Shadowflame Scythe (Forsworn, Falmer, Dwarven, Dragon Priest by tier; sheathe it for your flasks), six flasks; wonder: the Mutagen Staff; Morag Tong set.
Spellsword: the Spellbound Rapier (Steel, Ebony, Daedric, Dragonbone by tier; its look follows the spell in your other hand), touch spells; wonder: the Dragon Slayer; Ahzidal's set.

Every item climbs Base, Tier I, II, III and Ascended. Ascended adds damage only; it keeps Tier III's model. Class weapons wear their look from Tier I. Class sets: hoods only, a class-colour aura that grows; Tier III sets breathe and trail wisps.
Class spells

Destruction: Fire: Firebolt → Fireball → Incinerate → Immolate; Frost: Ice Spike → Ice Storm → Icy Spear → Throat of the World; Shock: Chain Lightning → Shock Nova → Finger of the Mountain → Lightning Strike; Sun: Solar Flare → Sunbeam → Forbidden Sun → Daybreak; Arcane: Arcane Bolt → Mana Void → Lunar Tide → Apocalypse; Walls: Wall of Flames → Wall of Frost → Wall of Storms → Inferno; Storms: Frost Nova → Lightning Storm → Multivortex → Cinder Storm

Summoner: Beasts: Conjure Wolf → Conjure Ice Wolf → Conjure Alpha Wolf → Conjure Werebear; The Dead: Conjure Skeleton → Conjure Draugr Wight → Conjure Draugr Deathlord Warrior → Conjure Draugr Death Overlord; Daedra: Conjure Dremora → Conjure Dremora Archer → Conjure Dremora Mage → Conjure Dremora Warlock; Dwemer: Conjure Dwarven Spider → Conjure Dwarven Sphere → Conjure Dwarven Centurion → Conjure Dwarven Ballista Master; The Wild: Conjure Spriggan → Conjure Spriggan Matron → Conjure Burnt Spriggan → Conjure Spriggan Earth Mother; Atronachs: Conjure Flame Atronach → Conjure Frost Atronach → Conjure Storm Atronach → Conjure Storm Monarch; Ash: Conjure Ash Spawn → Conjure Ash Husk → Conjure Ash Spawn Immolator → Conjure Ash Guardian; The Night: Conjure Death Hound → Conjure Volkihar Hound → Conjure Gargoyle → Conjure Gargoyle Brute; The Wrath: Conjure Mistman → Conjure Wrathman → Conjure Wrathman Marksman → Conjure Wrathman Warlock

Spellsword: Fire: Burning Touch → Flame Touch → Fiery Grasp; Frost: Chilling Touch → Icy Touch → Freezing Grasp; Shock: Shocking Touch → Static Touch → Thundering Grasp; Sun: Sunlight Touch → Radiant Touch → Searing Grasp; Arcane: Arcane Edge → Arcane Brand → Arcane Cascade

Every ability one custom effect (Nov 25, tools/abilityfx.py): relics, Tablet weapons, wonders, Alduin's Bane, class weapons, all 43 combat spells and the flasks - the style Noah picked, built from Skyrim's own textures, grown and faded by the game exactly as the workshop draws it, replacing what played before (nothing borrowed round it). Conjurations keep Skyrim's portal; the Soulcaller keeps the Staff of Magnus beam; the Mutagen Staff has no beam (a flask every 0.5 s while blocking).
Flasks (Alchemist)

Fire Flask, Frost Flask (2 cities freed), Shock Flask (4), Acid Flask (6), Holy Water (8), Voidglass Flask (9). Each bursts, leaves its ground, and has a tier power (Firestorm, Frost Nova, Lightning Strike, Mana Void then Lunar Tide).
Dragon Priest relics
Jailor's Keyhammer (Vahlok, Riverwood): Hits shackle the dead in place. Heavy: chains yank the nearby dead together.
Mistblade (Nahkriin, Whiterun): Hits blind the dead: they slow and hit weaker. Heavy: a fog where they wander lost.
Windcutter (Volsung, Solitude): Light: a gust that staggers the dead 8 m ahead. Heavy: a 12 m cone that knocks them down.
Glacier Greatsword (Zahkriisos, Windhelm): Hits freeze the dead until they die. Heavy: shatters every frozen one around you.
Storm Blade (Otar, Markarth): Hits chain lightning to 2 more of the dead. Heavy: lightning arcs to all around you.
Sacrifice Knife (Rahgot, Riften): Hits poison, spreading to the next of the dead. Heavy: every poisoned one bursts.
Grief Blade (Krosis, Falkreath): Hits heal you 1%. Heavy: a wail that weakens the dead around you.
Sealbreaker (Hevnoraak, Morthal): Hits shatter armour. Heavy: a shockwave that staggers all around you.
Nightcaller's Scythe (Vokun, Dawnstar): Hits put the dead to sleep. Heavy: a nightmare fog that slows them.
Arcane Maul (Morokei, Winterhold): Hits burst with magic. Heavy: a magicka shockwave that refills your magicka.

Each relic's hits and heavy are its own effect on Skyrim's (tools/fxown.py): Keyhammer green paralyze + metal sparks; Mistblade illusion light, heavy waterfall mist; Windcutter shout bursts; Glacier frost impact + icicles, heavy frost explosion + ice-wraith burst; Storm Blade shock impact, heavy mass shock; Sacrifice Knife poison spray, heavy Dragonborn poison gas; Grief Blade red absorb + vampire drain, heavy dark burst; Sealbreaker metal sparks + green absorb; Nightcaller purple illusion, heavy shadow burst + mist; Arcane Maul drain absorb, heavy Staff of Magnus impact.
Tablet of Mysteries
The only gamble: a donated weapon, worn or battered, with a number of uses; lost if you fall.
Stormtalons: Glass claws. Every 3rd hit chains lightning to 2 more of the dead. Heavy: stuns.
Gravebell Mace: A mace. Every 5th hit tolls the bell, stunning the dead within 5 m.
Talons of Woe: Dragonbone claws. Their bleeding runs twice as deep, and kills heal you a little.
Riverstone Halberd: A halberd. Hits knock the dead back. Heavy: splits the ground in a line ahead.
Wyrmspine Pike: A pike. Thrusts pierce 2 more of the dead in a line. Heavy: a shockwave that staggers the dead within 8 m.
Rimewick Quarterstaff: A quarterstaff. Light: freezes the dead for 3 s. Heavy: a 10 m blizzard for 6 s.
Cinderclaws: Ember claws. Every swipe sets the dead burning. Heavy: a fan of embers.
Eclipse Edge: A greatsword. Hits alternate frost and sun. Heavy: an ice shockwave, then a sun shockwave (10 m).
The Wandering Star: A wand. Hold to cast a gold star every 0.5 s that bounces to up to 4 of the dead. Every 5th hit throws them far.
Frostmourn Rapier: A rapier. Thrusts slow the dead. Heavy: freezes a ring of the dead around you.
Silver Reaping Scythe: A scythe. Every 4th hit: a silver flash that briefly slows the dead.
Bonereaper: A scythe. 1 kill in 4 rises to fight for you for 20 s.
Wyrmtooth Scythe: A scythe. Hits make the dead bleed. Heavy: a shockwave that staggers the dead within 8 m.
Bloodmoon Scythe: A scythe. Hits drain blood to heal you. Heavy: drains everything it touches.

Each Tablet weapon's hits its own effect on Skyrim's: Eclipse Edge in Dawnguard's eclipse burst, Bloodmoon heavy in its blood explosion, Bonereaper in the reanimate flash, Riverstone heavy in the giant's slam, Gravebell in gold turn-undead, Wyrmspine Pike dragonfire, Cinderclaws fireball, Frostmourn ice, Silver Scythe moon light, Wyrmtooth blood spray and tail stomp, Wandering Star Auriel's sky bolt, Talons blood mist.
Wonders, secrets and the last weapon

Wonders: Soulcaller's Staff (white soul-gem glow on its glass head), Wyrmspine Javelin (throw only; it leaves your hand until it returns, flies bare, bursts in its element, Dragonfire look on its head; a solid model, the bones overlapping), Mutagen Staff (Living Mutagen glow on its head), Dragon Slayer.
Hidden quests: wyrm, sixfires, vortex, slayer.
Alduin's Bane, from the Hall of the Awakened: a meteor on each light hit (landing in Alduin's own explosion), a white tornado on heavy.
Weapon looks

Every relic, wonder and class weapon tier wears its own look (Nov 25: "custom weapon looks ... not changing their model or adding something on top"): five looks designed for each weapon (tools/weaponlooks.py), all light on its own edges and faces, many in two colours, built from our textures and Skyrim's own enchantment membranes at 2K (4K on the wonders and Alduin's Bane). Noah's picks are in (Nov 25): third looks on the Grief Blade, Storm Blade, Sacrifice Knife, Nightcaller's Scythe, Glacier Greatsword, Rimewick and Radiant Quarterstaff; second looks on the Windcutter, Bloodmoon Scythe and Frostmourn; the Keyhammer's first look in green; the rest their first.
No pieces laid over the weapons (the Nov 25 signatures - chains, crystals, seals, rings - retired) and no shared look families.

Effects come to a point at the tips and ends; quarterstaffs glow on their heads only; the Gravebell doesn't pulse. Scythes 25% larger. Our own scythes (tools/scythes.py): nine, each from Skyrim's own weapons of its make - a battleaxe's pole (a Dragon Priest's staff, a pair of spines) and a sword's blade bent into a crescent, its guard as the collar - in the game now (Nov 25: Noah's OK, with the blade flush where it meets the haft on Wyrmtooth, Silver Reaping and Bloodmoon).

Nov 25 evening: two more looks for every weapon (five each); the scythes' joins fixed - Wyrmtooth, Silver Reaping and Bloodmoon's blades square to the haft, the Dragon Priest's blade lower and clamped round the staff.

Nov 26: every weapon art rebuilt from the looks the workshop shows (the shock rapier and Storm Blade had been older builds); the nine scythe blades and the Bonereaper's skull turned the right way out (they were see-through).
Ability effects

Every ability rebuilt from real parts (Nov 25: "All of the abilities need a complete remake ... hyper realistic and 3D ... as highly polished and visually satisfying as the mods we used" - "Rebuild from their real parts"): the real particle effects of Skyrim, Dawnguard, Dragonborn, Apocalypse and Mysticism (fire, smoke, sparks, shockwaves - 61 of them) put together into one new effect per ability (tools/realfx.py, 84 effects: relics, Tablet weapons, wonders, Alduin's Bane, class weapons' bolts and cyclones, the javelin's landings, the flasks), each in its own colour and size, each part on its own beat, the ground ones laid on the ground. Noah's style, colour and size picks from the workshop drive them.

The workshop shows a close picture of each built from the real parts themselves (Nov 25: "Build from real parts"): their own textures and particle settings, read from your game; bolts, the javelin's bounce, the sunbeam and the meteors on the paths and beats the game gives them. The game plays the real thing.
The class spells play their own (Noah: "we can use the spells from the actual mods and base Skyrim for those"): no impact of ours over them.

Vahlok's chains: a heavy hit throws spectral chains (real 3D links, Skyrim's enchantment fire in green) from the one struck to each of the dead within 6 m, keeps them taut while it hauls them in to arm's reach, then lets go.
Alduin's Bane heavy: a wind blast within 10 m that hurls the dead far: Skyrim's Labyrinthian shockwave, Unrelenting Force and waterfall mist, in white (Nov 25: "Shockwave").
The Radiant Quarterstaff's sunbeam all in white (Nov 25): its bolt from the sky, burst, turning pillar and motes (fxmap.ini sun_*_white); Holy Water keeps the gold.
Summons come out of Skyrim's own conjuring portal (Nov 25: "Use skyrims summon portal"): the Soulcaller's wolves and sabre cat.
Retired: the Nov 25 flat 'own effect' elements (tools/abilityfx.py) and the borrowed-impact list (tools/fxown.py).

Five options of its own per ability (Nov 25: "different variations of what the weapon is actually doing"): what it does picks its kind (a chain, a stun round you, a freeze, a fog, a pull...), and each has five ways to show it from real parts, with any colour and sliders for size, brightness, area of effect (also how far it reaches in game), vibrance, speed, linger, density and light cast (tools/abilityopts.py).
The workshop pictures show the night's own dead (the Thriceborn) reacting as the game makes them, and you as a male Nord in the weapon's class set holding it.
Brews, shouts and perks

Brews (Nordic): Troll's Hide Mead, Wellspring Draught, Stormrunner Brew, Bounty Hunter's Ale, Last Stand Ale, Gilded Tongue Tonic, Dragonsblood Cider, Pack Leader Mead, Grave Fury Wine, Bone Burst Brew, Overflow Tea, Ember Echo Ale, Mana Font Draught, Volatile Tincture, Quickhand Elixir, Catalyst Philter, Bladesong Mead, Spellbinder's Draught, Spellguard Ale, Quick Revive Draught. Kept through death, up to 9 held, about 3,000 each, refundable at half.
Shouts: each freed altar teaches one; Solitude's is Tiny Terrors (normal dead shrink to knee height for 20 s and die in one hit). Whiterun gives Dragon's Updraft.
The screen
Edge UI throughout; the night counter is a glowing ember number inside the red moon; beside it the wave and the dead left.
Only these pop-ups: the Carian Wand and Mutagen Staff hints, the Dragon Priest slain card, and the small callouts (essence, style tags, round tally, hit marker). No crosshair marks.
The MCM: subtitles on/off and size, Echo Altar voice volume, screen shake and the rest.
Taken out (so they never come back as suggestions)

Class voice lines (kept in Noah's Downloads only). Runic look. Repeat the Echo (now Hold the Light). The screen-drawn ring, runes and wisps. Dance of Death. Floating motes beside weapons. The relics' built-in effect pillars.

Old kit: guns, altar bows and crossbows, staves, power-ups (until Nordic boons), crew picker, Atronach Reforge, Bone-Throne, Runes, Cloaks, breath spells, relic infusions, the Summoner's heroes and armies, the old wonders (Frostbinder Gauntlets, Wolf Queen's Crown, Horn), the Ranger class.

Mods turned off Nov 26 (Mod stack picks): ENB Light, Faction Crossbows, OffhandBows, Bow Charge Plus, Calling of the Conjurer, Gondorian Ranger Armor, Black Mage Armor SE, Populated Dungeons, The Restless Dead, Rogues 'n Raiders and its 3 add-ons, VAE, Vibrant Weapons Lite, Mihail's Bone Colossus, Old God, Giant Family, Fogling and Indrik Mounts. Traps were declined. The Elixir stays out.

Enemies taken out Nov 26: every caster (necromancers, cultists, prophets, liches, skeleton mages), the skeleton soldiers and heroes of Rogues 'n Raiders and the Restless Dead, ghosts, Undead Blades, draugr overlords and reapers, Draman, daedroth, dremora, clannfear, hybrids, werewolves, wereskeevers, the soul wraith, the Immortal Draugr Overlord boss, eight mini-bosses and the Resonant Centurion. The Radiant Quarterstaff's sky-bolt heavy (now Holy Water's pillar).
Nov 26 evening: the night and wave banners, the between-wave countdown, the weapon hints, the blood-moon night counter; Tamrielic Grass, Veydosebrom, Origins of Forest.
